PB-01 and PB-02 are both Ready again, and I committed the change as `fa1286f`. The commit includes `probes/PB-01-sharadar-coverage/delisted.csv`, with the starts left blank as you said, so C6 checks only the end dates. Your `.env` files and `out/` folders are confirmed ignored by git.

`dt` still flags both probes as stale. That's because the results already saved are from the old code, and it clears once you rerun.

When you have time, run these in order, then say "ran it" (no need to paste output):

| Command | Time |
|---|---|
| `python3 probes/PB-01-sharadar-coverage/probe.py check` | Under a minute |
| `python3 probes/PB-01-sharadar-coverage/probe.py history` | A few minutes |
| `python3 probes/PB-01-sharadar-coverage/probe.py bulk` | Up to about an hour |
| `uv run probes/PB-02-yahoo-coverage/public.py all` | About 5 minutes |
| `uv run probes/PB-02-yahoo-coverage/probe.py universe` | 15–30 minutes |

AD-03 still names the Nasdaq Data Link client; it should name `api.sharadar.com`, where your key comes from. architecture-design needs to fix that before `ingest` is planned.

Next is `/dev-team:pipeline-design`, which writes the first pipelines for `quant`, `deep`, `server` and `web`. It can go ahead while the probes wait for your runs; only build-planning has to wait for their results.
